name: Dodo
summary: Melbourne discount ISP founded 2001 by Larry Kestelman; acquired by M2 Group 2013 ($204M), now a Vocus retail brand (DODO SERVICES PTY LTD, ACN 158 289 331).

events.details: Founded in Melbourne by Larry Kestelman (co-founder Michael Slepoy).

Acquired by M2 Group in 2013 ($204M); M2 merged into Vocus Communications (Feb 2016). Dodo continues as a Vocus retail brand; current entity DODO SERVICES PTY LTD (ACN 158 289 331) registered 17 May 2012 and still active (per ABR).
